missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Милиция' is the feminine nominative subject of 'приехала', which agrees in the feminine. 'Очень быстро' is an adverbial phrase of manner. A clean factual report.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Милицию' is the accusative direct object of 'вызвал'. 'Свидетель' is the nominative subject, and 'вчера' sets the time. A core emergency pattern.
Strategic focus: Genitive with preposition. 'Милиции' is the genitive form after 'около', here referring to the police station. 'Машина' is the nominative subject. A useful spatial pattern.
Strategic focus: Dative after a verb. 'Милиции' is the dative case governed by 'обратился' with 'к', meaning to turn to. 'Немедленно' adds urgency. A common help-seeking pattern.

Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'В милиции' uses the prepositional form 'милиции' after 'в' to say where people work. 'Разные люди' is the nominative subject. An everyday institutional pattern.

Strategic focus: Instrumental of agent. 'Милицией' is the instrumental case naming the agent in this passive-style sentence. 'Преступника' is the animate accusative object. A natural law-enforcement context.

Strategic focus: Dative after a verb. 'Милиции' is the dative case governed by 'доверяю', which takes the dative. 'Местной' agrees in the feminine dative, and 'полностью' intensifies the trust. A trust pattern.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О милиции' uses the prepositional form 'милиции' after 'о' to express the topic. 'Подробно' adds detail. A natural reporting pattern.

Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Милиции' is the genitive form within the 'у' possession frame. 'Новые машины' is the nominative plural subject. A standard possession pattern with a plural object.
Strategic focus: Genitive with preposition. 'Милиции' is the genitive form after 'без', expressing the absence of police. 'Город' is the nominative subject. A natural generalising statement.
